Package org.jdesktop.lg3d.mandela.lang

Enum Class TokenKind

java.lang.Object
java.lang.Enum<TokenKind>
org.jdesktop.lg3d.mandela.lang.TokenKind
All Implemented Interfaces:
Serializable, Comparable<TokenKind>, Constable
public enum TokenKind extends Enum<TokenKind>
The lexical classes of the Mandela language.

The lexer maps every character of a source file onto exactly one of these kinds, so the parser never looks at raw characters. Keywords are not modelled as separate kinds: they arrive as IDENT and the parser tests Token.text() against Keywords — which keeps Mandela's contextual words (such as init or a field named type) legal identifiers and makes the reserved-word set a single, editable constant.

NEWLINE is a real token: Mandela separates statements by line as well as by ;, so the lexer has to know where lines end. It suppresses the token inside brackets and after a token that cannot end a statement, which is what lets a script break a long expression across lines without any trailing-comma or line-continuation ceremony.

    • continuesStatement

      public boolean continuesStatement()
